Title: Some admins' Usage reports may contain stale data in Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins' Usage reports may contain stale data in Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: This Usage data refresh issue affects the following reports:

- OneDrive Usage reports
- SharePoint Usage reports
- Group Activity reports
 

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Usage reports and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some admins' Usage reports may contain stale data in Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins' Usage reports may contain stale data in Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: This Usage data refresh issue affects the following reports:

- OneDrive Usage reports
- SharePoint Usage reports
- Group Activity reports
 
These reports may not have refreshed since September 8, 2026.

Current status: We've identified that our upstream data pipeline is encountering refresh errors and failures when retrieving up-to-date data for the listed reports, which is resulting in this impact. We're implementing a solution to the affected pipeline to restore the normal processing flow and recover delayed data as swiftly as possible. We anticipate being able to provide a timeline for resolution by our next scheduled communications update.

Scope of impact: Some admins and users in North America, Asia Pacific, and Europe attempting to see up-to-date data in the affected reports listed in the More info section may be impacted by this issue. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Sunday, September 13, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Root cause: Our upstream data pipeline is encountering refresh errors and failures when retrieving up-to-date data for the listed reports, which is resulting in this impact. 

Next update by: Monday, September 14, 2026, at 7:00 PM UTC
